proposed_resolution: In the hand-written region, reject any reference to TIER, ROLE or OVERRIDE, reject RUN[ and Object.assign(RUN, and reject any tier: key outside the two adoption forms. Have TIER_KEY_RE reject a model: or effort: value that holds a quoted literal anywhere before the next , or }. End a ' or " string at an unescaped newline, which JavaScript forbids, or report the file, so that a misread / cannot hide what follows. Add one test for each form.
